ruleDefinitions.name: New PDQDeploy Service - Server Side
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects a PDQDeploy service installation which indicates that PDQDeploy was installed on the machines.
PDQDeploy can be abused by attackers to remotely install packages or execute commands on target machines
 Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath, ServiceName

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*PDQDeployService\\\.exe.*") OR (ServiceName = "PDQDeploy" OR ServiceName = "PDQ\ Deploy")))
